lead: Priya Dutt is best known as an Indian politician, born on 28 August 1966 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, she is 60 years old, and her birth date places her under the Virgo sign.
She has held the office of Member of the 14th Lok Sabha and Member of the 15th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Priya facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Priya Dutt — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Priya Dutt was born on 28 August 1966 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Sunil Dutt and her mother, Nargis. She is a sibling of Sanjay Dutt.
She received her education at Sophia College for Women and University of Mumbai.

sections.heading: Priya Dutt — Career and Professional Work
paras: Priya Dutt works primarily as a politician.
She has held the following offices: Member of the 14th Lok Sabha (2005–2009) and Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–present). She is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
